name: gsd-blocker-recovery
description: GSD blocker and failed-run recovery authority. Use when a GSD run is blocked or paused on an auto-pause blocker, a Task attempt failed, a recovery action exists, or anyone asks to "clear the blocker", "unblock the run", "resolve the pause", or "resume the failed task". Explains the two enforced routes: blocker resolution is cleared only by the human in the native terminal, and a Task recovery resume is one gated continuation after a real repair with concrete evidence — never a state-surgery bypass.
